rationale: The original failed-bounce thesis is intact — price is coiling in a tight 15.55-15.58 range just under the declining 9-EMA with volume fading into the pivot (16k → 4.7k shares), a pattern consistent with a bear flag rather than accumulation, and no bullish catalyst has appeared. MAE of only -0.10% shows the market is not rejecting the short, and the defined risk to the $15.68 stop (~$83) fits comfortably within the $465 remaining loss budget. Flipping long has no support given the persistent relative weakness on 5.3x relative volume, so the asymmetry still favors giving the short room to work toward the $15.29 session-low retest.
